title: ISLAMICLEGALBENCH: EVALUATING LLMS KNOWLEDGE AND REASONING OF ISLAMIC LAW ACROSS 1,200 YEARS OF ISLAMIC PLURALIST LEGAL TRADITIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance and reasoning across seven diverse schools of Islamic jurisprudence (Sunni and Shi'i) using a multi-school benchmark to detect 'legal monoculture' and over-representation of specific online religious sources.

Prompting models with False Premise Queries (FPQs) that contain deliberately incorrect assumptions about Islamic law to measure the rate at which models sycophantically accept the false premises versus challenging them.
